erin: 30-minute preflight for midnight change window. quick checklist run? @oncall @mike :alarm_clock:

mike: On it. Canary health: green. DB migration dry-run succeeded. Traffic-shift playbook loaded and verified.

jess: Monitoring ready — dashboards wired, alerts for 5xx and latency >700ms set, logs retention 48h. Will watch metrics during ramp.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started · canary-id=c-311 · version=release-2026-03-20 · pinned=false · progress=10% :rocket:

erin: Reminder — pin the release after canary hits 15% and smoke passes. If we need to revert, use:
```
./deploy rollback --to=release-2026-03-19 --env=prod --reason="canary-failure"
```

mike: Quick check — fallback variant for embeddings is configured? If the quantized model errors spike, we should route to v1.7.

jess: Confirmed. routing.fallback=model:v1.7 threshold=5% errors. Also added autoscale headroom + cache warmup.

carol: Release notes are posted (internal): https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-20 — included known issues and rollback instructions.

erin: Plan: if canary passes at 15% at T+20m, pin and then ramp to 100% over 40m in staged increments. Keep ops and eng channels open.

oncall: I'm on standby. Pager severity raised for this window. Hotfix lane prepped per runbook.

erin: Pinning now.
